approvers: Developer / main contractor, glazing subcontractor, site project manager
reason: Protection is set in the subcontract package, so the developer or main contractor decides what is specified and who pays. I do not buy this today and a new supplier means a new budget line I would have to fight for on every job.
objection: No Maltese reference job, and if the coating damages a client's glass I carry the risk while the cover stops at 2,500 euro. Cheap film and tape do the job well enough already, and I do not want another line item to defend to the developer.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape, plus a cleaning crew at handover, and push damage cost back to the glazing subcontractor.
would_change_my_mind: A developer or main contractor that specifies it in the package and pays for it as a separate line, with a local reference job and a damage cover well above 2,500 euro.
